extraction.name: RoboBench
extraction.description: RoboBench is a comprehensive benchmark that systematically evaluates multimodal large language models (MLLMs) as embodied brains. It spans 14 capabilities, 25 tasks, and 6092 QA pairs across five dimensions: instruction comprehension, perception reasoning, generalized planning, affordance prediction, and failure analysis.
extraction.creator: Yulin Luo; Chun-Kai Fan; Menghang Dong; Jiayu Shi; Mengdi Zhao; Bo-Wen Zhang; Cheng Chi; Jiaming Liu; Gaole Dai; Rongyu Zhang; Ruichuan An; Kun Wu; Zhengping Che; Shaoxuan Xie; Guocai Yao; Zhongxia Zhao; Pengwei Wang; Guang Liu; Zhongyuan Wang; Tiejun Huang; Shanghang Zhang
extraction.citeAs: Yulin Luo, Chun-Kai Fan, Menghang Dong, Jiayu Shi, Mengdi Zhao, Bo-Wen Zhang, Cheng Chi, Jiaming Liu, Gaole Dai, Rongyu Zhang, Ruichuan An, Kun Wu, Zhengping Che, Shaoxuan Xie, Guocai Yao, Zhongxia Zhao, Pengwei Wang, Guang Liu, Zhongyuan Wang, Tiejun Huang, Shanghang Zhang. ROBOBENCH: A COMPREHENSIVE EVALUATION BENCHMARK FOR MULTIMODAL LARGE LANGUAGE MODELS AS EMBODIED BRAIN. arXiv preprint arXiv:2510.17801v1, 2025.
extraction.rai:dataCollection: The dataset was assembled by combining large-scale real-world open-source robotic datasets with curated in-house collection of robotic data.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionType: Secondary Data analysis; Physical data collection
extraction.rai:dataCollectionMissingData: The authors note a lack of real-world planning failure data, which required them to synthesize planning-level failures by perturbing correct instructions.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: High-quality robotic videos and large-scale real-world robotic datasets (including Open X-Embodiment, RH20T, RoboMIND, and others) alongside in-house robotic data.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Gemini generates structured annotations—task summaries, step-wise instructions with timestamps, and metadata—which are refined by human annotators. Human annotators also manually labeled relative positions, keypoint changes, and bounding boxes linking instructions to target objects. Execution-level failures were labeled by experts, and 20 professionally trained annotators conducted quality inspections validating linguistic clarity, answerability, and correctness.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: planning-level failures are synthesized by perturbing correct instructions due to lack of real-world planning failure data
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: evaluating MLLMs as the cognitive core for robotic manipulation; guide the development of next-generation MLLMs toward more robust robotic intelligence
extraction.rai:dataManipulationProtocol: Implicit instructions are obtained by rewriting explicit instructions into demand-based requests using LLMs. Additionally, planning-level failures are synthesized by perturbing correct instructions (wrong object, missing step, wrong order) due to lack of real-world planning failure data.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Data filtering is applied during construction using general criteria (image quality and task validity) and task-specific filters (e.g., excluding single-arm data from dual-arm tasks). During post-construction validation, items that all models solve correctly are removed, whereas items all models fail to solve undergo manual review and correction.
